test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the 'Termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Fixed waiting time value from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The trackside is configured to never send an acknowledgement. The defined number of repetitions from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 is known (e.g., N).
test_cases.test_inputs: Fixed waiting time and defined number of repetitions from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N. The fixed waiting time is T.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message (1st send).
steps.expected: Message sent.

steps.action: Wait for time T. No acknowledgement received.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the message (1st repetition).

steps.action: Repeat the wait and repetition process until the defined number of repetitions (N) has been reached.
steps.expected: The OBU has sent the message a total of N+1 times (initial + N repetitions).

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T after the last sending (the Nth repetition). No acknowledgement is received.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated. No further 'Termination of communication session' messages are sent.

test_cases.title: Session not considered terminated if acknowledgement received after last repetition
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The trackside is configured to send an acknowledgement only after the last repetition's waiting time has started but before it elapses, or specifically to test the boundary, let's assume the acknowledgement is received *after* the last repetition is sent but *within* the final waiting time.
test_cases.test_inputs: Fixed waiting time and defined number of repetitions from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message and repeats it N times, with the fixed waiting time T between each, receiving no acknowledgements for the first N sends.
steps.expected: The OBU has sent the message N+1 times.

steps.action: After the last sending (Nth repetition), the trackside sends an acknowledgement within the fixed waiting time T.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the acknowledgement. The session is terminated via acknowledgement, not by timeout. The OBU does not wait for the full timeout to declare termination by timeout, but the session is effectively terminated. The requirement states 'if no acknowledgement is received... it shall consider... terminated'. Since an acknowledgement *was* received, the timeout condition is not met, but the session is still terminated. The test verifies that the timeout logic does not erroneously trigger if an ack arrives.

steps.action: Cause the safe radio connection to be lost (condition [6] part 1) and stop the requests to set up the connection for a reason other than successful set-up (condition [6] part 2).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, indication status is 'Connection Up', and the 'connection status' timer is running.

steps.action: Release the safe radio connection (condition [5] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, indication status is 'No Connection', and the 'connection status' timer is running.

steps.action: Allow the 'connection status' timer to expire (condition [2] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Indication of RIU connection status for current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, train is in a supervised mode, GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to the network, and the train is located within an infill area served by an RIU. A safe radio connection with the RIU is established.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The display shows the indication status 'Connection Up' corresponding to the RIU of the current infill area.

test_cases.title: Indication of RIU connection status when connection is lost
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, train is in a supervised mode, GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to the network, and the train is located within an infill area served by an RIU. The safe radio connection with the RIU is lost and the 'connection status' timer has expired.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The display shows the indication status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' corresponding to the RIU of the current infill area.

test_cases.title: Valid train position stored upon passing LRBG when position is invalid
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train position is 'invalid'. An LRBG is located ahead of the train in the direction of travel.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The status of the train position changes from 'invalid' to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU for the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Valid train position stored upon passing ORBG when position is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train position is 'unknown'. An ORBG is located ahead of the train in the direction of travel.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The status of the train position changes from 'unknown' to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU for any previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: Any previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab A is currently active. The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the front of the train as the side of Cab A (the active cab).

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab B was the last active cab. Currently, no cab is active (e.g., both cabs are closed or in a state where they do not define orientation).

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the front of the train as the side of Cab B (the last active cab).

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for supervising location based information
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The OBU is supervising a location-based event (e.g., a Movement Authority limit) that does not have a specific exception defined in SUBSET-026 for using a different reference.

steps.action: Trigger the supervision of the location-based event.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated front end position of the train as the reference for the supervision calculation.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start location
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching the End Section timer start location. The OBU is in a mode where the End Section timer is active.

steps.action: Move the train to the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the max safe front end position as the reference for determining when the End Section timer starts, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Min safe rear end used for passing a level transition border
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching a level transition border (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1). The OBU is supervising the passage of this border.

steps.action: Move the train to the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the min safe rear end position as the reference for determining when the level transition border is passed, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBG (Linking checked)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. Linking consistency check is enabled on-board. The train has passed a balise group (BG1) that is marked as 'linked' and is contained in the previously received linking information. The train position is valid.

steps.action: The train passes BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG1 as the LRBGONB (Last Reported Balise Group On-Board).

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG1 as the location reference.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message (e.g., MA) referring to BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to BG1.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBG (Linking not checked)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. Linking consistency check is disabled on-board. The train has passed a balise group (BG2) that is not marked as 'unlinked'. The train position is valid.

steps.action: The train passes BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG2 as the LRBGONB.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG2 as the location reference.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message referring to BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to BG2.

test_cases.title: Accepting trackside information referring to recent LRBGs
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, BG3, BG4, BG5, BG6, BG7, BG8. BG8 is the current LRBGONB. The RBC is aware of these reported LRBGs.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8, as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message referring to BG8 (the most recent LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message referring to BG1 (the 8th most recent LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside information referring to outdated LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. The OBU has reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, BG3, BG4, BG5, BG6, BG7, BG8, BG9. BG9 is the current LRBGONB. The RBC is aware of these reported LRBGs.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8. BG1 is the 9th most recent LRBG and is therefore outside the acceptance window.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message referring to BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or ignores the location reference, as BG1 is not among the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unknown LRBG (Unlinked balise passed)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. The train has passed a balise group (BG3) marked as 'unlinked'. No LRBG compliant balise group has been passed since then. The train position is valid but referred to an unlinked balise group.

steps.action: The OBU prepares a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the LRBG identifier in the position report to 'unknown'.

steps.action: The train passes a new balise group (BG4) that is LRBG compliant (e.g., linked and announced, or not unlinked).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the LRBGONB to BG4.

steps.action: The OBU sends the next position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG4 as the location reference.

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a defined train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed in the direction corresponding to the train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction (matching train orientation).

steps.action: Pass a balise group transmitting data identified as valid for the nominal direction while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account (e.g., updates position or applies speed profile).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information not valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a defined train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data identified as valid for the reverse direction only (opposite to train orientation).

steps.action: Pass a balise group transmitting data identified as valid for the reverse direction only while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information (no state change, no error related to the data content itself, just ignored).

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group, or orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for one direction only (nominal or reverse).

steps.action: Receive data from a transmission medium where the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside device direction, and the data is valid for one direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid in both directions when orientation cannot be related
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group, or orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: Receive data from a transmission medium where the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside device direction, and the data is valid for both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data (takes it into account).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value validity and incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received continuous profile data. New continuous profile data is received with multiple values and incremental distances.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data structure: Value(1) for Distance(1), Value(2) for Distance(2), Value(3) for Distance(3). Distances are unsigned increments.
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is known and stored.

steps.action: Receive continuous profile data where Value(n) is valid for Distance(n+1). Verify that Value(1) applies over Distance(1) using previously received data for the start.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(1) over the first incremental distance, using previously received data for the initial segment if applicable.

steps.action: Verify that Value(2) applies over Distance(2) and Value(3) applies over Distance(3).
steps.expected: The OBU correctly maps each value to its corresponding incremental distance.

steps.action: Verify the last value (Value(3)) in the received data.
steps.expected: The last value applies for an unlimited distance unless it is a special 'end of profile' value.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: zero distance handling
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data where Distance(n+1) is 0 for a specific value n.

steps.action: Receive continuous profile data where a distance increment is 0.
steps.expected: The corresponding profile value n is still taken into account by the OBU.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: unsigned incremental distances and previous data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data. New location data is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data structure with unsigned incremental distances between consecutive values.
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received location data is stored.

steps.action: Receive location data where distances are given as unsigned incremental values representing the distance between value(n) and value(n-1).
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the distances as unsigned increments between consecutive values.

steps.action: Verify the application of data over the first distance (Distance(1)).
steps.expected: The previously received data remains in use over the first distance.

steps.action: Verify that each value in the location data can represent a single value or a set of data.
steps.expected: The OBU correctly processes values whether they are single values or sets of data.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: elements and overlapping
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with multiple elements (value(n) for length(n)), where starts are given by unsigned incremental distances. Elements are defined to overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data or initial/default values are available for the first distance.

steps.action: Receive non-continuous profile data where distance to the start of each element is given as unsigned incremental values from the start of the previous element.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the distances as unsigned increments between the starts of consecutive elements.

steps.action: Verify the first element's distance.
steps.expected: The first distance uses the previously received data or initial data/default values.

steps.action: Provide non-continuous profile data where elements overlap (length of element n-1 is greater than distance to start of element n).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and processes the overlapping elements correctly.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: distances and values
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information structure with distances to announced balise groups and linking data values.

steps.action: Receive linking information where the first distance is the distance to the first announced balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the first distance as the distance to the first announced balise group.

steps.action: Receive linking information where subsequent distances are the distances between consecutive announced balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets each further distance as the distance between consecutive announced balise groups.

steps.action: Verify the values in the linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets each value as the linking data of the corresponding balise group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Linking information is stored containing a location accuracy value for Balise Group BG1. The train is in a mode where position is valid.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy value from the linking information for BG1.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: No linking information is stored for Balise Group BG2. A National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current area. The train is in a mode where position is valid.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value for the location accuracy of BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: No linking information is stored for Balise Group BG3. No National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current area. The train is in a mode where position is valid.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG3, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of BG3.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined from linking information. New linking information is received that contains a different location accuracy value for BG1.

steps.action: The OBU processes the new linking information.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains unchanged and is not updated to the new value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined. Linking consistency checking is subsequently disabled.

steps.action: The OBU operates with linking consistency checking disabled.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined. The train enters an area where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.

steps.action: The OBU operates in the new area.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains unchanged and is not updated to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where position is valid. The reference balise group has a known location accuracy. The over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. The situation does not require consist length uncertainty (e.g., train length is fully known or not applicable).

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end by the sum of the location accuracy and the under-reading amount. The max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end by the sum of the location accuracy and the over-reading amount.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored. The train passes Balise Group BG1 (linked, in linking info), then BG2 (unlinked), then BG3 (linked, in linking info).

steps.action: The train passes BG1.
steps.expected: BG1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: The train passes BG2.
steps.expected: BG1 remains the SOLR because BG2 is unlinked.

steps.action: The train passes BG3.
steps.expected: BG3 becomes the SOLR because it is linked and in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. The train passes Balise Group BG1, then BG2.

steps.action: The train passes BG1.
steps.expected: BG1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: The train passes BG2.
steps.expected: BG2 becomes the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives linking information that triggers a change in the SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received linking information.
steps.expected: The linking replacement rule is applied before the SOLR is updated.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for other information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information referred to a balise group different from the current SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location based information.
steps.expected: The information is relocated to the SOLR before the corresponding replacement rule is applied.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information that can be processed into min, estimated, and max location items.

steps.action: The OBU processes the location based information.
steps.expected: The information is processed into up to three location items: min, estimated, and max.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. Linking information provides the distance between FRBG and SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU relocates the location items to the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The distance between FRBG and SOLR is subtracted from the location items' distances, using the value from linking information.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. Linking information is not available for the distance between FRBG and SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU relocates the location items to the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The estimated, min, or max travelled distance between FRBG and SOLR is computed and subtracted from the location items' distances, with appropriate min/max adjustments.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train moving, position report parameters active.

steps.action: The train decelerates and reaches standstill (speed = 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train at standstill.

steps.action: The train accelerates from standstill (speed > 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by mode change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode.

steps.action: A mode change occurs (e.g., FS to SH due to brake application).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: The level changes (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by driver integrity confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., brake application in FS mode).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by RBC/RBC border crossing (max safe front end)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train passes an RBC/RBC border with its max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established, RBC contact information available.

steps.action: A communication session is successfully established with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, no position report parameters stored on-board.

steps.action: The train passes an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by error detection
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: An error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4 is detected.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The report contains train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'No integrity information' without length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The report contains train integrity status 'No integrity information' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The report contains train integrity status 'Lost' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The report contains train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., brake application in FS mode).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: The conditions for transition to 'No integrity information' are met (e.g., specific mode change or reset as per Table 2c).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Train integrity is confirmed by an external source (e.g., trackside system).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored (e.g., from a balise group). The train is moving. The geographical position display is currently inactive.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position display is currently active on the DMI.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected a geographical reference balise group. The track kilometre reference value and offset are known. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer is functioning correctly and the distance travelled is measurable.

steps.action: Record the geographical position displayed immediately after passing the geographical reference balise group (distance travelled ≈ 0).
steps.expected: The displayed position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Allow the train to travel a known distance D (e.g., 100 meters) from the reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the distance travelled D to the previous reference-based position.

steps.action: Request the geographical position display on the DMI.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the initial reference position plus the distance D travelled.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Standstill mode. Roll-away protection is active. The train is not associated with a specific balise group for position reference (e.g., in a section without balises or after a position reset).
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default value for Roll-away distance (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the internal 'remaining distance' variable for verification.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll-away protection supervision (e.g., by entering Standstill mode or triggering the specific protection logic).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the configured Roll-away distance value (e.g., 10 m).

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU regarding the remaining distance for Roll-away protection.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is correctly initialized to the full supervised distance, independent of any balise group position.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance to run is defined by a National/Default value, RBC transmission, or driver input.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance value (e.g., 500 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the internal 'remaining distance' variable for verification.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a defined maximum distance (e.g., 500 m).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the defined SR distance value.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU regarding the remaining distance for SR mode.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is correctly initialized to the full supervised distance.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision with forward movement
test_cases.preconditions: Roll-away protection is active. The train is at the start location of the supervision. The estimated distance travelled is initially 0.
test_cases.test_inputs: Roll-away distance: 10 m. Odometer reading: 0 m at start.
test_cases.assumptions: The train moves in the direction concerned by the supervision. The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled away from the start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m (estimated distance).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 10 m - 5 m = 5 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 3 m (total estimated distance 8 m).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 10 m - 8 m = 2 m.

steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data. The new gradient profile and speed restrictions are applied and visible in the driver display.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from main-signal balise group replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, approaching a main signal balise group, a valid MA is currently stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message at the main signal containing a new non-infill MA with different data.

steps.action: Pass the main signal balise group transmitting a new non-infill MA with updated data.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data from the balise group.

test_cases.title: Infill MA replaces only data beyond the next main signal
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, an MA is stored that includes data for sections before and after the next main signal balise group (BGb). Linking information for BGb is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received from a preceding balise group (BGa) that refers to BGb, containing new data for sections beyond BGb.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA from BGa while the train is before BGb.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the infill MA. The data for sections before BGb remains unchanged from the previous MA.

steps.action: Pass the main signal balise group BGb.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the new data from the infill MA for sections beyond BGb. The data for sections before BGb remains as it was before receiving the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA starts a new section at the infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, an MA is stored. Linking information for the next main signal balise group (BGb) is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received from a preceding balise group (BGa) that refers to BGb.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA from BGa.
steps.expected: The OBU starts a new MA section at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal (BGb). The section timer for this new section starts when the train passes BGb.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL while supervising LOA is treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, OBU is supervising an LOA (Limit of Authority) with no defined SvL (Stop Location). Location-based information (e.g., gradient profile) is stored for the area beyond the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC defining an SvL located far ahead of the current LOA.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL while the OBU is supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening. The stored location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., gradient profile) beyond the new SvL is deleted.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL closer than current SvL is treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, OBU is supervising an MA with a defined SvL. Location-based information is stored for the area beyond the current SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC defining an SvL that is closer to the train than the current SvL.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with a closer SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening. The stored location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 between the new SvL and the old SvL is deleted.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, an MA is stored. Linking information announces a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information received from a balise group.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information that updates the length of the current MA section.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the MA section length but does not treat this as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted as a result of this update.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, OBU is supervising an MA with a defined SvL. Location-based information is stored for the area beyond the current SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC that ends with an LOA (no SvL defined).

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening. The stored location-based information is not deleted due to the change from SvL to LOA.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of MA shortening when train is in rear of ISL
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established, train running in FS/OS/LS/AD with a valid MA and complete track description stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA, a mode profile, and a list of balise groups for SH area. The train front end position is in rear of the Indication supervision limit of the proposed MA.

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA with a proposed MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list, where the train front end is in rear of the proposed MA's Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request and adopts the proposed shortened MA, the accompanying mode profile, and the list of balise groups for SH area as the new MA data.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the decision.
steps.expected: The RBC is informed that the request to shorten the MA has been accepted.

test_cases.title: Rejection of MA shortening when train is in advance of ISL
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established, train running in FS/OS/LS/AD with a valid MA and complete track description stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA, a mode profile, and a list of balise groups for SH area. The train front end position is in advance of the Indication supervision limit of the proposed MA.

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA with a proposed MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list, where the train front end is in advance of the proposed MA's Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previously received MA, mode profile, and list of balise groups for SH area valid.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the decision.
steps.expected: The RBC is informed that the request to shorten the MA has been rejected.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at ISL
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established, train running in FS/OS/LS/AD with a valid MA and complete track description stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA. The train front end position is exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear' for acceptance and 'in advance' for rejection. The case where the position is exactly at the limit is interpreted as not being 'in rear', thus triggering the rejection path to ensure safety (fail-safe).

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA where the train front end is exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed MA.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request (as the train is not in rear of the ISL) and keeps the previously received MA, mode profile, and list of balise groups for SH area valid.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the decision.
steps.expected: The RBC is informed that the request to shorten the MA has been rejected.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores announcement for unsupported infill medium and continues with previous information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. The OBU is not equipped with a specific infill transmission medium (e.g., Radio Infill Unit capability is disabled or hardware absent). The OBU has previously received valid movement authority and location information from a balise group or loop.
test_cases.test_inputs: An announcement balise group requesting the unsupported infill medium (e.g., Radio Infill).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's configuration explicitly lacks the requested infill medium capability.

steps.action: The train passes an announcement balise group that requests an infill transmission medium for which the OBU is not equipped.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the announcement information. No new infill session is initiated, and no error related to the missing medium is raised that would alter the current driving mode.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's movement authority and speed profile after passing the announcement balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to run according to the previously received information (previous MA and speed profile remain active and unchanged).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, LS or AD; linking information stored (including the main signal balise group BGa); loop infill area information stored and a communication session with the loop infill unit established.

steps.action: Level 1, loop infill session established; the train passes and reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reading of the main signal balise group.

steps.action: After reading the main signal balise group, the OBU receives new infill information from the loop referring to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the infill information (its infill MA is not applied: no trip, no emergency brake).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, LS or AD; linking information stored (including the main signal balise group BGa with reaction 'no reaction'); loop infill area information stored and a communication session with the loop infill unit established.

steps.action: Level 1, loop infill session established; the train's min safe antenna position passes the last possible location of the next main signal balise group (plus detection margin) without detecting it.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the balise group as missed.

steps.action: After detecting the missed balise group, the OBU receives new infill information from the loop referring to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the infill information (its infill MA is not applied: no trip, no emergency brake).

test_cases.title: Order to establish RIU session ignored when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The train is in Level 1 operation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a specific RIU.

steps.action: The train reads a balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. No communication session is established with the RIU. The OBU continues Level 1 operation without radio infill.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing RIU session and establishment of new one upon reaching location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with GSM-R installed. An existing communication session with RIU-A is active. The train is approaching the location specified in a new balise group order for RIU-B.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group order to establish a session with RIU-B, specifying a location ahead of the current position.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or can switch sessions as per its configuration.

steps.action: The train reaches the location indicated in the balise group order for RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to establish a new communication session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a communication session with RIU-B as soon as it is able to handle the new session.

test_cases.title: Order via RIU ignored in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An existing session with RIU-A is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order received via RIU-A to establish a communication session with RIU-B.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order via the active RIU-A session to establish a communication session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The existing session with RIU-A is maintained. No new session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: Information sent to RIU upon entering infill area and reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The balise group order specifies a location for entry into the infill area and the identifier of the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the specified entry location and subsequently reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: The train passes the location given in the balise group order (entry into the infill area).
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating entry into the infill area.

steps.action: The train reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the next main signal balise group has been read.

test_cases.title: Information sent to RIU upon detecting missed next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The balise group order specifies the identifier of the next main signal balise group. The train is expected to read this balise group but fails to detect it.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the expected location of the next main signal balise group without detection.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect missed balise groups based on position and expected balise data.

steps.action: The train passes the expected location of the next main signal balise group without reading it, and the OBU detects that the balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the next main signal balise group was missed.

test_cases.title: Content of information sent to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The OBU is about to send information to the RIU (e.g., upon entering the infill area).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger event for sending information to RIU (e.g., passing entry location).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's ETCS-ID, current position, and time are known and valid.

steps.action: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The transmitted message includes the train identity (ETCS-ID), a position report, the identifier of the next main signal balise group, and a time stamp.

test_cases.title: Consistency check of radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The RIU sends radio infill data that violates consistency rules defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 (e.g., inconsistent speed profiles or invalid identifiers).
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with intentional inconsistencies (e.g., speed limit lower than previous without valid reason, or invalid balise identifier).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific consistency rules from SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 are implemented in the OBU.

steps.action: The OBU receives radio infill data from the RIU that fails the consistency check.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the inconsistent data. The OBU does not apply the inconsistent infill information to its supervision. An error or warning may be logged.

test_cases.title: Ignoring further radio infill after reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The OBU has read the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to the already read next main signal balise group.

steps.action: After reading the next main signal balise group, the OBU receives further radio infill information related to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further radio infill information. The supervision remains unchanged based on the last valid data.

test_cases.title: Ignoring further radio infill after detecting missed next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session. The OBU has detected that the next main signal balise group was missed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to the missed next main signal balise group.

steps.action: After detecting the missed next main signal balise group, the OBU receives further radio infill information related to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further radio infill information. The supervision remains unchanged based on the last valid data.

test_cases.title: Termination of RIU session upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order (via balise group or RIU) to terminate the communication session.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside (balise group or RIU) to terminate the communication session with the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: Termination of RIU session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active RIU session.
test_cases.test_inputs: A change of operational level from Level 1 to another level (e.g., Level 2 or Level 0).

steps.action: The OBU changes its operational level from Level 1 to another level (e.g., Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges a received emergency message with its identifier
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, radio session with the supervising RBC is established. The OBU is in a mode where it can receive and process emergency messages (e.g., FS, OS, SR, LS, SB, TR, PT, RV, AD, or SM).
test_cases.test_inputs: An emergency message with a unique identifier (NID_EM) sent by the RBC.

steps.action: The RBC sends an emergency message to the OBU containing a specific identification number (NID_EM).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the emergency message and stores it.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (Message 147: Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop) to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message contains the field NID_EM with the same value as the identification number in the received emergency message.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges a repeated emergency message with the same identifier
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, radio session with the supervising RBC is established. The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with identifier NID_EM_1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated emergency message with the same identifier (NID_EM_1) sent by the RBC.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new emergency message to the OBU with the same identification number (NID_EM_1) as a previously received and acknowledged message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and replaces the previous one with the same identifier.

steps.action: The OBU processes the repeated emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message contains the field NID_EM with the value NID_EM_1.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepting conditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in Full Supervision (FS) with a valid Movement Authority (MA). The train has not passed the new stop location defined in the emergency stop message.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Conditional Emergency Stop message with a new stop location within the current EOA/LOA. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message with a valid identifier and parameters.

steps.action: Send a conditional emergency stop message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message, defines a new EOA/SvL with no release speed, and displays the emergency stop indication.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU while the emergency stop is active.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The current supervision (emergency stop) remains unchanged, and the new MA is not applied.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepting unconditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in Full Supervision (FS) with a valid Movement Authority (MA).
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Unconditional Emergency Stop message. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send an unconditional emergency stop message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and trips the train immediately (Emergency Brake).

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU while the emergency stop is active (before revocation).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The train remains in the emergency state, and the new MA is not applied.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of new MA after revocation of emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in Full Supervision (FS). A conditional emergency stop has been accepted and is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Revocation message for the active emergency stop. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the active emergency stop.
steps.expected: The OBU revokes the emergency stop. The previous supervision state (or a new MA if provided with the revocation) is restored.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU after the revocation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and updates the supervision accordingly.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of an emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, mode FS, OS, LS or SM, radio session established with the RBC. An emergency message with a valid identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.

steps.action: The RBC sends a revocation message referring to the identifier of the previously received emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: The OBU processes the revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement to the RBC according to the general acknowledgement procedure (SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5), referring to the time stamp of the revocation message.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of an emergency message in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, OS, LS or SM, radio session established with the RBC. An emergency message with a valid identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.

steps.action: The RBC sends a revocation message referring to the identifier of the previously received emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: The OBU processes the revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement to the RBC according to the general acknowledgement procedure (SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5), referring to the time stamp of the revocation message.

test_cases.title: OS modunda ray kenarından gelen hız sınırının ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: Tren On-Sight (OS) modundadır. Ulusal değer (V_NVONSIGHT) 30 km/h olarak tanımlıdır. Ray kenarı, OS modu için 20 km/h hız sınırı göndermiştir.

steps.action: Tren, ray kenarından gelen 20 km/h hız sınırının geçerli olduğu alana girer.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen hızı 20 km/h olarak uygular. Ulusal değer olan 30 km/h uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: LS modunda ray kenarından gelen hız sınırının ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: Tren Limited Supervision (LS) modundadır. Ulusal değer (V_NVLIMSUPERV) 100 km/h olarak tanımlıdır. Ray kenarı, LS modu için 80 km/h hız sınırı göndermiştir.

steps.action: Tren, ray kenarından gelen 80 km/h hız sınırının geçerli olduğu alana girer.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen hızı 80 km/h olarak uygular. Ulusal değer olan 100 km/h uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: SH modunda ray kenarından gelen hız sınırının ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: Tren Shunting (SH) modundadır. Ulusal değer (V_NVSHUNT) 30 km/h olarak tanımlıdır. Ray kenarı, SH modu için 15 km/h hız sınırı göndermiştir.

steps.action: Tren, ray kenarından gelen 15 km/h hız sınırının geçerli olduğu alana girer.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen hızı 15 km/h olarak uygular. Ulusal değer olan 30 km/h uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: OS modunda ray kenarı hız sınırı ulusal değerden yüksekse ulusal değerin uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren On-Sight (OS) modundadır. Ulusal değer (V_NVONSIGHT) 30 km/h olarak tanımlıdır. Ray kenarı, OS modu için 40 km/h hız sınırı göndermiştir.

steps.action: Tren, ray kenarından gelen 40 km/h hız sınırının geçerli olduğu alana girer.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen hızı 40 km/h olarak uygular. Ray kenarı değeri ulusal değerden yüksek olduğu için ray kenarı değeri geçerlidir.

test_cases.title: LS modunda ray kenarı hız sınırı ulusal değerden düşükse ray kenarı değerinin uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren Limited Supervision (LS) modundadır. Ulusal değer (V_NVLIMSUPERV) 100 km/h olarak tanımlıdır. Ray kenarı, LS modu için 90 km/h hız sınırı göndermiştir.

steps.action: Tren, ray kenarından gelen 90 km/h hız sınırının geçerli olduğu alana girer.
steps.expected: OBU, izin verilen hızı 90 km/h olarak uygular. Ray kenarı değeri ulusal değerden düşük olduğu için ray kenarı değeri geçerlidir.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation upon receipt of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a driving mode (FS, OS, LS or AD) with a valid Movement Authority. No PBD speed restriction is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside transmits a non-continuous profile containing PBD data (start/end location, PBD distance, brake type, gradient).

steps.action: Trackside sends the PBD data to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the speed restriction to ensure permitted braking distance based on the received data.

steps.action: Verify the speed profile displayed or monitored by the OBU.
steps.expected: The calculated PBD speed restriction is present in the speed profile between the specified start and end locations.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction recalculation only when inputs change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has already calculated a PBD speed restriction based on initial trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Trackside sends identical PBD data again. 2. Trackside sends PBD data with a changed gradient value.

steps.action: Trackside sends the same PBD data (no change in inputs) to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not recalculate the speed restriction; the existing restriction remains unchanged.

steps.action: Trackside sends new PBD data where the gradient value is different from the previous one.
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the speed restriction to ensure permitted braking distance based on the new gradient value.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions for PBD speed restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with known train parameters (rotating mass, brake characteristics). Trackside sends PBD data requiring calculation.
test_cases.test_inputs: PBD data with specific gradient, PBD distance, and brake type (Emergency).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal calculation logic is accessible via logs or a test interface to verify the applied assumptions.

steps.action: Trigger the PBD speed restriction calculation with the received data.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the rotating-mass-compensated gradient value in the calculation.

steps.action: Inspect the deceleration curves used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The safe deceleration is computed without considering trackside adhesion profiles, brake inhibition, or powerless section conditions. The EBD curve reaches zero speed at the permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check the fixed assumptions used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The estimated acceleration is set to zero. The speed-inaccuracy compensation, processing delay (T41), brake feedback times (T_bs1, T_bs2), and traction cut-off time (T_traction) are set to the fixed values defined in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4, regardless of actual configuration.

test_cases.title: SBD curve calculation for service brake PBD
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a driving mode. Trackside sends PBD data specifying that the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the Service Brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: PBD data with brake type set to Service Brake.

steps.action: Trigger the PBD speed restriction calculation with the Service Brake PBD data.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates both an EBD curve and an SBD curve.

steps.action: Inspect the SBD curve used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The SBD curve is based on the expected deceleration (ignoring brake inhibition and powerless section conditions) and reaches zero speed at the permitted braking distance.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation for emergency brake
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a driving mode. Trackside sends PBD data specifying that the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the Emergency Brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: PBD data with brake type set to Emergency Brake and a PBD distance that allows for a non-zero speed restriction.

steps.action: Trigger the PBD speed restriction calculation with the Emergency Brake PBD data.
steps.expected: The OBU computes the PBD speed restriction as the speed satisfying the EBD-based inequalities of SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6.

steps.action: Verify the calculated speed value.
steps.expected: The calculated speed is rounded down as specified in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6 and is greater than zero.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction set to zero when no speed satisfies inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a driving mode. Trackside sends PBD data specifying that the permitted braking distance is to be achieved with the Emergency Brake.

test_cases.title: Inactivity timeout terminates AAL2 session
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is authenticated in an AAL2 session. The inactivity timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14 (assumed to be 1 hour for testing).
test_cases.assumptions: The inactivity timeout is set to a short testable duration (e.g., 1 minute) in the test environment to avoid waiting for the production value of 1 hour.

steps.action: Wait for the inactivity timeout period to elapse without performing any session activity.
steps.expected: The session is terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource or continue the session.
steps.expected: Access is denied and the user is prompted to reauthenticate.

test_cases.title: Session activity resets inactivity timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is authenticated in an AAL2 session. The inactivity timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14 (assumed to be 1 hour for testing).
test_cases.assumptions: The inactivity timeout is set to a short testable duration (e.g., 2 minutes) in the test environment.

steps.action: Perform a session activity (e.g., click a button or navigate to a page) just before the inactivity timeout expires.
steps.expected: The inactivity timer is reset.

steps.action: Wait for the original inactivity timeout duration to elapse from the start of the session, but less than the timeout duration from the last activity.
steps.expected: The session remains active and is not terminated.

test_cases.title: Overall timeout terminates AAL2 session
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is authenticated in an AAL2 session. The overall timeout value is defined in VBP SDD §14 (assumed to be 24 hours for testing).
test_cases.assumptions: The overall timeout is set to a short testable duration (e.g., 5 minutes) in the test environment to avoid waiting for the production value of 24 hours.

steps.action: Wait for the overall timeout period to elapse, performing periodic session activities to prevent inactivity timeout.
steps.expected: The session is terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource or continue the session.
steps.expected: Access is denied and the user is prompted to reauthenticate.

test_cases.title: Successful reauthentication resets both timeouts
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is authenticated in an AAL2 session. The inactivity and overall timeouts are defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.assumptions: Timeouts are set to short testable durations in the test environment.

steps.action: Wait until the inactivity timeout is about to expire, then trigger the reauthentication prompt.
steps.expected: The system prompts for reauthentication.

steps.action: Complete the reauthentication process successfully.
steps.expected: The session continues, and both the inactivity and overall timeouts are reset.

steps.action: Wait for the original inactivity timeout duration to elapse from the start of the session.
steps.expected: The session remains active because the inactivity timer was reset by reauthentication.

test_cases.title: Reauthentication with password only after inactivity timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen or company representative is authenticated in an AAL2 session. The inactivity timeout has occurred but the overall timeout has not yet occurred.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows reauthentication using only a successful password or biometric comparison in conjunction with the session secret, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §5.2 for AAL2.

steps.expected: The session is suspended or terminated, and a reauthentication prompt is shown.

steps.action: Provide the correct password (or biometric) to reauthenticate.

test_cases.title: Citizen session persists after e-Devlet assertion validity window expires
test_cases.preconditions: A valid citizen account exists. The e-Devlet test IdP is configured to issue assertions with a short validity window (e.g., 5 minutes). VBP is configured to allow sessions longer than the assertion validity window.
test_cases.assumptions: The VBP session timeout is configured to be longer than the e-Devlet assertion validity window (e.g., VBP session: 30 minutes, Assertion: 5 minutes).

steps.action: Sign in as a citizen via e-Devlet federation.
steps.expected: The citizen session is established successfully at VBP.

steps.action: Wait until the e-Devlet assertion validity window has expired (e.g., wait 6 minutes if the window is 5 minutes).
steps.expected: The VBP session remains active. The user is not logged out or prompted to re-authenticate solely due to the assertion expiration.

steps.action: Perform a standard authenticated action within VBP (e.g., view a profile page or submit a form).
steps.expected: The action is processed successfully without requiring a new e-Devlet assertion or re-authentication.

test_cases.title: VBP session termination is independent of assertion validity
test_cases.preconditions: A valid citizen account exists. The e-Devlet test IdP issues assertions with a validity window shorter than the VBP session timeout.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP session timeout is set to a specific value (e.g., 10 minutes) which is longer than the assertion validity window (e.g., 2 minutes).

steps.action: Sign in as a citizen via e-Devlet federation.
steps.expected: The citizen session is established.

steps.action: Wait for the VBP session timeout period to elapse (e.g., 11 minutes), ensuring the assertion validity window has already expired.
steps.expected: The VBP session is terminated due to the VBP session timeout policy, not because of the assertion validity window.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource in VBP.
steps.expected: The user is redirected to the login page or receives a session expired message, consistent with VBP's session management policy.

test_cases.title: VBP assertion request contains identifier and nonce
