test_cases.title: Merkezi kayıt yönetim sistemine aktarım hatasında otomatik uyarı gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Portal ve arka ofis bileşenleri çalışmaktadır. Merkezi kayıt yönetim sistemi (Log Management System) erişilemez hale getirilebilmelidir (örneğin ağ kesintisi veya servis durdurma). SOME ve nöbetçi yönetici uyarı kanalları (e-posta/SMS) test ortamında izlenebilir durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati veya uyarı zamanlayıcısı test amacıyla hızlandırılabilir veya 15 dakikalık bekleme süresi test ortamında beklenilebilir.

steps.action: Merkezi kayıt yönetim sistemine bağlantıyı keserek veya servisi durdurarak kayıt aktarım hatası oluşturulur.
steps.expected: Portal ve arka ofis bileşenleri hata durumunu algılar ve merkezi sisteme aktarımı durdurur veya tamponlar.

steps.action: Hatanın oluşumundan itibaren 15 dakika beklenir (veya sistem saati 15 dakika ileri alınır).
steps.expected: KHGM SOME ekibi ve nöbetçi yöneticiye otomatik olarak hata uyarısı gönderilir.

steps.action: Gönderilen uyarıların içeriği ve zamanlaması kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Uyarılar, hatanın kaynağını (Portal veya Arka Ofis) ve türünü (aktarım hatası) içermeli ve 15 dakikalık eşiği aşmamış olmalıdır.

test_cases.title: Kayıt üretimi sırasında oluşan hata durumunda otomatik uyarı mekanizması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal bileşeni çalışmaktadır. Kayıt üretim mekanizması (logging agent) yapılandırması bozulacak şekilde değiştirilebilmelidir (örneğin yazma yetkisi kaldırma veya disk doluluğu simülasyonu). SOME ve nöbetçi yönetici uyarı kanalları izlenmektedir.
test_cases.assumptions: Kayıt üretim hatası, merkezi sisteme aktarım hatasından bağımsız olarak tetiklenebilmelidir.

steps.action: Portal bileşeninde kayıt üretiminin başarısız olmasına neden olacak bir hata durumu oluşturulur (örneğin log dosyasına yazma yetkisinin kaldırılması).
steps.expected: Bileşen, kayıt üretemediğini tespit eder ve hata durumunu içsel olarak işaretler.

steps.action: Hatanın oluşumundan itibaren 15 dakika beklenir (veya sistem saati 15 dakika ileri alınır).
steps.expected: KHGM SOME ekibi ve nöbetçi yöneticiye otomatik olarak 'Kayıt Üretimi Hatası' uyarısı gönderilir.

steps.action: Uyarı kanallarından gelen bildirimler incelenir.
steps.expected: Bildirimler, hatanın kayıt üretimi aşamasında oluştuğunu belirtmeli ve 15 dakikalık SLA'ya uygun zamanda ulaşmalıdır.

test_cases.title: Geçerli e-Devlet imzası ile oturum açma
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegre edilmiştir. e-Devlet test IdP'si, VBP'nin doğrulama anahtarına sahip olduğu bir anahtar çiftiyle imzalama yapabilmektedir. Test vatandaş hesabı mevcuttur.

steps.action: Vatandaş olarak e-Devlet üzerinden giriş başlatılır ve e-Devlet tarafından VBP'ye gönderilen assertion'ın imzası, e-Devlet'in doğrulama anahtarıyla doğrulanabilir şekilde imzalanmış olduğundan emin olunur.
steps.expected: VBP assertion'ı kabul eder ve vatandaş oturumu açılır.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz imzalı assertion'ın reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegre edilmiştir. VBP'ye assertion gönderilebilecek bir ara katman (örneğin intercepting proxy) mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: Assertion içeriği değiştirilmeden sadece imza kısmı bozulabilir veya farklı bir anahtarla imzalanabilir.

steps.action: VBP'ye, e-Devlet'in doğrulama anahtarıyla doğrulanamayan (örneğin farklı bir anahtarla imzalanmış veya imzası bozulmuş) bir assertion gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP assertion'ı reddeder ve oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Beklenmeyen IdP'den gelen assertion'ın reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegre edilmiştir. VBP'ye assertion gönderilebilecek bir ara katman mevcuttur. VBP'nin güvenmediği başka bir IdP'nin doğrulama anahtarı VBP'de tanımlı değildir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP, assertion'ın issuer alanını ve imza doğrulamasını birlikte değerlendirir.

steps.action: VBP'ye, beklenen e-Devlet IdP'si dışında başka bir IdP tarafından imzalanmış (ve VBP'nin doğrulama anahtarına sahip olmadığı) bir assertion gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP assertion'ı reddeder ve oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of a valid e-Devlet assertion
test_cases.preconditions: A valid, unused e-Devlet assertion is available for a test citizen identity.

steps.action: Present a valid, unused e-Devlet assertion to VBP.
steps.expected: VBP accepts the assertion and establishes a session for the citizen.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a replayed e-Devlet assertion
test_cases.preconditions: A valid e-Devlet assertion has already been successfully presented to VBP and accepted.

steps.action: Present the exact same e-Devlet assertion to VBP a second time.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the assertion and does not establish a new session.

test_cases.title: VBP başlatır: Vatandaş girişinde federasyon isteğinin VBP'den gelmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test kimlik sağlayıcısına (IdP) entegre edilmiştir. Bir vatandaş test hesabı mevcuttur. Federasyon trafiğini yakalamak için bir proxy veya ağ izleme aracı hazırdır.

steps.action: Vatandaş portalına giriş yapmak için VBP arayüzünden 'e-Devlet ile Giriş' seçeneği kullanılır.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı, VBP'nin yetkilendirme uç noktasına (authorization endpoint) bir istek gönderir. Bu istek, e-Devlet'e yönlendirilmeden önce VBP tarafından başlatılmıştır.

steps.action: Yakalanan ağ trafiğinde, e-Devlet'e giden ilk federasyon isteğinin kaynak adresi incelenir.
steps.expected: İsteğin kaynağı VBP sunucusu veya VBP'nin tarayıcıdaki oturumudur. e-Devlet'in VBP'ye bir federasyon isteği başlatmadığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: VBP başlatır: e-Devlet'in VBP'ye federasyon isteği başlatamaması
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test kimlik sağlayıcısına entegre edilmiştir. e-Devlet tarafında VBP'ye doğrudan bir federasyon isteği göndermeyi simüle edebilecek bir test aracı veya sahte IdP (test double) mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet'in VBP'ye doğrudan bir federasyon isteği başlatması, NIST SP 800-63C-4 §2.3'e göre FAL2 seviyesinde beklenen davranış değildir ve VBP bunu desteklememelidir.

steps.action: e-Devlet test IdP'si (veya sahte IdP) üzerinden, VBP'nin yetkilendirme uç noktasına (authorization endpoint) doğrudan bir federasyon başlatma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP bu isteği reddeder veya yok sayar. Oturum başlatılmaz ve kullanıcıya hata mesajı veya yönlendirme yapılmaz.

steps.action: VBP'nin logları veya güvenlik kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: İsteğin VBP tarafından reddedildiğine veya beklenmeyen bir kaynak geldiğine dair bir kayıt bulunur. Oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Unsuccessful applicant receives generic error message for mismatched data
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created with self-asserted information that does not match the authoritative source data (e.g., incorrect date of birth).
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant credentials and self-asserted data with a known mismatch.

steps.action: Submit the proofing and enrolment request with the mismatched self-asserted information.
steps.expected: The system rejects the application and displays a generic error message indicating that the application was unsuccessful, without specifying which field or data point failed verification.

test_cases.title: Unsuccessful applicant receives generic error message for missing data
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created with self-asserted information that is missing a required field (e.g., no date of birth provided).
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant credentials and self-asserted data with a missing required field.

steps.action: Submit the proofing and enrolment request with the missing required field.
steps.expected: The system rejects the application and displays a generic error message indicating that the application was unsuccessful, without specifying that the date of birth was missing or failed verification.

test_cases.title: Unsuccessful applicant receives generic error message for invalid document
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant account is created with an invalid or expired identity document.
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant credentials and an invalid identity document.

steps.action: Submit the proofing and enrolment request with the invalid identity document.
steps.expected: The system rejects the application and displays a generic error message indicating that the application was unsuccessful, without specifying that the document was invalid or expired.

test_cases.title: Validation of core attributes against an authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant with valid core attributes (e.g., TCKN, name, date of birth) that match the records in the authoritative source (e.g., Nüfus ve Vatandaşlık İşleri) is available. The VBP test environment is configured to query the authoritative source.
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant details matching the authoritative source.

steps.action: Initiate the IAL2 proofing process for a company representative and enter core attributes that exactly match the authoritative source records.
steps.expected: The system successfully validates the core attributes against the authoritative source and proceeds to the next step of the proofing process.

steps.action: Check the system logs or audit trail for the attribute validation event.
steps.expected: The logs confirm that the validation method used was comparison against an authoritative or credible source and that the result was successful.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant possesses a valid SUPERIOR evidence document (e.g., a digital ID card or mobile driver's license) with digitally signed core attributes. The VBP test environment is configured to verify digital signatures using the issuer's public key.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUPERIOR evidence with valid digital signatures.

steps.action: Initiate the IAL2 proofing process and present the SUPERIOR evidence containing digitally signed core attributes.
steps.expected: The system validates the digital signatures using the issuer's public key and confirms the accuracy of the core attributes.

steps.action: Check the system logs or audit trail for the attribute validation event.
steps.expected: The logs confirm that the validation method used was digital signature verification on SUPERIOR evidence and that the result was successful.

test_cases.title: Rejection of core attributes that do not match the authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant with core attributes that intentionally differ from the authoritative source records (e.g., incorrect date of birth) is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Applicant details with one core attribute mismatched against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Initiate the IAL2 proofing process and enter core attributes where one attribute (e.g., date of birth) does not match the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system fails the attribute validation and displays an error message indicating that the provided information could not be verified.

steps.action: Check the system logs or audit trail for the attribute validation event.
steps.expected: The logs record the validation failure and specify which attribute did not match the authoritative source.

test_cases.title: Rejection of SUPERIOR evidence with invalid digital signature
test_cases.preconditions: A test applicant possesses a SUPERIOR evidence document with a tampered or invalid digital signature on the core attributes.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUPERIOR evidence with an invalid or tampered digital signature.

steps.action: Initiate the IAL2 proofing process and present the SUPERIOR evidence with the invalid digital signature.
steps.expected: The system fails the digital signature verification and rejects the evidence, displaying an error message indicating that the document could not be validated.

steps.action: Check the system logs or audit trail for the attribute validation event.
steps.expected: The logs record the failure of the digital signature verification and the rejection of the SUPERIOR evidence.

test_cases.title: IAL2 company representative proofing notification content and delivery
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with a mock notification service (email/SMS) that captures outgoing messages. A company representative identity with a validated postal address and phone number is prepared for IAL2 proofing.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification service is configured to log the full content and recipient address of all outgoing proofing notifications.

steps.action: Complete the IAL2 identity proofing process for the company representative using valid evidence.
steps.expected: The proofing process completes successfully and the system triggers the notification workflow.

steps.action: Inspect the captured notification message sent to the applicant's validated address.
steps.expected: The notification is sent to the validated postal address or phone number associated with the applicant.

steps.action: Verify the content of the notification message against NIST SP 800-63A-4 §3.10 requirements.
steps.expected: The notification includes: (1) details about the identity proofing event including the name of the identity service and the date of completion; (2) clear instructions and contact information for the recipient to dispute their participation; (3) information about how the organization protects the security and confidentiality of collected information; (4) information about the recipient's responsibilities as a subscriber.

test_cases.title: Notification not sent when IAL2 proofing fails
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with a mock notification service. A company representative identity with invalid or mismatched evidence is prepared for IAL2 proofing.

steps.action: Attempt IAL2 identity proofing for the company representative using evidence that fails validation (e.g., mismatched government identifier).
steps.expected: The proofing process fails and no account is established.

steps.action: Check the notification service logs for any outgoing proofing notifications to the applicant's address.
steps.expected: No notification of proofing is sent to the applicant's validated address.

test_cases.title: Knowledge-based verification is not used during company representative proofing
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with a valid company representative applicant account and access to the proofing flow.

steps.action: Initiate the identity proofing process for a company representative.
steps.expected: The system presents verification methods that do not include knowledge-based verification (e.g., security questions, personal history questions).

steps.action: Complete the identity proofing process using the available non-KBV methods.
steps.expected: The proofing process completes successfully without prompting for any knowledge-based verification.

test_cases.title: Email is not offered as an out-of-band authentication method
test_cases.preconditions: A registered user account with at least one out-of-band authenticator (e.g., mobile phone) already bound.

steps.action: Navigate to the security settings or authenticator management page of the user account.
steps.expected: The list of available out-of-band authentication methods does not include 'Email' or 'E-posta' as an option for receiving authentication secrets.

steps.action: Initiate an out-of-band authentication request for the account.
steps.expected: The system sends the authentication secret via the bound non-email channel (e.g., SMS or push notification) and does not provide an option to send it via email.

test_cases.title: Email cannot be bound as an out-of-band authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A registered user account with no out-of-band authenticators bound, or a test account where the binding process can be initiated.

steps.action: Attempt to add a new out-of-band authenticator by selecting 'Email' from the list of available methods, if such a selection is presented in the UI.
steps.expected: The system does not allow the selection of Email as an out-of-band authenticator. If the UI does not present Email as an option, this step is verified by confirming the absence of the option in the previous test case.

steps.action: If the UI allows entering an email address in a field labeled for out-of-band binding, submit the request.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request with an error message stating that email is not supported for out-of-band authentication, or the field is not available for this purpose.

test_cases.title: SMS one-time code accepted only once during validity period
test_cases.preconditions: An active user account with SMS as a second factor bound to a verified test telephone number. A valid SMS one-time code has been generated and is within its validity period.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid SMS one-time code.

steps.action: Submit the valid SMS one-time code in the first authentication transaction.
steps.expected: VBP accepts the code and completes the authentication step successfully.

steps.action: Submit the same SMS one-time code in a second authentication transaction while it is still within its validity period.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the code as invalid or already used.

test_cases.title: Generating a new SMS code does not reset the failed authentication count
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with SMS bound as the second factor. The account has a non-zero failed authentication count (e.g., 1 failed attempt recorded).
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows the tester to observe the current failed authentication count or the state of the account regarding lockout thresholds.

steps.action: Initiate an authentication attempt and fail the SMS code verification once to establish a failed count of 1.
steps.expected: The system records the failed attempt. The account is not locked.

steps.action: Request a new SMS one-time code for the same account (e.g., by clicking 'Resend Code' or starting a new login flow that triggers code generation).
steps.expected: A new SMS code is sent to the registered telephone number.

steps.action: Check the failed authentication count for the account.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains at 1. It has not been reset to 0 by the generation of the new code.

test_cases.title: Failed count persists across multiple code generations before lockout
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with SMS bound as the second factor. The maximum allowed consecutive failed attempts is known (e.g., 5).
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum number of consecutive failed attempts before lockout is 5.

steps.action: Perform 4 failed authentication attempts using incorrect SMS codes, generating a new code after each failure.
steps.expected: After the 4th failure, the failed authentication count is 4. The account is not yet locked.

steps.action: Request a new SMS code (5th code generation) and attempt authentication with an incorrect code.
steps.expected: The 5th failed attempt is recorded. The failed authentication count reaches the maximum limit (5).

steps.action: Request a new SMS code (6th code generation) and attempt authentication.
steps.expected: The system enforces the lockout or restriction based on the 5th failure. The generation of the 6th code does not reset the count to allow further attempts beyond the limit.

test_cases.title: Password with only lowercase letters is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change or a new account is in the activation process.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting solely of lowercase alphabetic characters, at least 15 characters long, not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit a password consisting only of lowercase letters (e.g., 15 'a's) for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password without requesting additional character types.

test_cases.title: Password with only digits is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change or a new account is in the activation process.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting solely of numeric digits, at least 15 characters long, not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit a password consisting only of digits (e.g., 15 '1's) for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password without requesting additional character types.

test_cases.title: Password with only special characters is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change or a new account is in the activation process.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting solely of special characters (e.g., '!@#$%'), at least 15 characters long, not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit a password consisting only of special characters for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password without requesting additional character types.

test_cases.title: Password with only spaces is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change or a new account is in the activation process.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting solely of space characters, at least 15 characters long, not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit a password consisting only of space characters for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password without requesting additional character types.

test_cases.title: Password length validation with Unicode characters
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state. The system enforces a minimum password length of 15 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 15 Unicode characters (e.g., 15 distinct emoji or accented letters).
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length for company representatives is 15 characters, consistent with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 for single-factor authentication.

steps.action: Enter a password consisting of exactly 15 Unicode characters (e.g., 15 emoji).
steps.expected: The password is accepted as valid because the length is evaluated as 15 characters.

steps.action: Enter a password consisting of 14 Unicode characters.
steps.expected: The password is rejected because the length is evaluated as 14 characters, which is below the minimum.

test_cases.title: Password length validation with mixed ASCII and Unicode
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state. The system enforces a minimum password length of 15 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 10 ASCII characters and 5 Unicode characters.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum password length for company representatives is 15 characters.

steps.action: Enter a password consisting of 10 ASCII characters followed by 5 Unicode characters.
steps.expected: The password is accepted as valid because the total length is evaluated as 15 characters (10 + 5).

test_cases.title: Password length validation with surrogate pairs
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state. The system enforces a minimum password length of 15 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password consisting of 15 Unicode code points, some of which are represented by surrogate pairs in UTF-16 (e.g., emoji).
test_cases.assumptions: The system correctly implements Unicode code point counting as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2, not UTF-16 code unit counting.

steps.action: Enter a password consisting of 15 Unicode code points, where at least one character is an emoji that uses a surrogate pair in UTF-16 encoding.
steps.expected: The password is accepted as valid because the length is evaluated as 15 code points, not 16 or more UTF-16 code units.

test_cases.title: Password hint field is not available during password creation
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created or an existing representative is changing their password.

steps.action: Navigate to the password creation or change screen for a company representative.
steps.expected: The screen displays fields for the new password and confirmation, but does not display any field, checkbox, or option to enter or store a password hint.

test_cases.title: Password hint is not accessible on the login page
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a set password.

steps.action: Access the portal login page without authenticating.
steps.expected: The login form displays fields for username and password, but does not display any link, button, or text that reveals or provides a password hint for the account.

test_cases.title: Password hint is not accessible via 'Forgot Password' flow
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists.

steps.action: Click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and enter the representative's username or email address.
steps.expected: The system initiates the password reset process (e.g., sends a reset link) but does not display any password hint or partial password information on the screen.

test_cases.title: Password selection flow does not include security questions
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in a state where a password can be set or changed (e.g., initial registration or password reset).

steps.action: Initiate the password selection or change process for a company representative.
steps.expected: The system displays a form or interface for entering a new password.

steps.action: Observe the interface and any prompts presented during the password selection process.
steps.expected: No prompts, fields, or questions asking for knowledge-based information (e.g., 'name of first pet', 'mother's maiden name', 'first car') are displayed.

steps.action: Enter a valid password and confirm the selection.
steps.expected: The password is accepted without requiring answers to any security questions.

test_cases.title: Verification of a long password without truncation
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a known, valid password that is at least 64 characters long and not on the blocklist.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid password of 64 characters.

steps.action: Submit the full 64-character password for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and authenticates the user successfully.

steps.action: Submit a password that is the first 32 characters of the valid 64-character password.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password as incorrect.

test_cases.title: Verification of a password with trailing whitespace
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a known, valid password.
test_cases.test_inputs: The valid password with a single trailing space character.
test_cases.assumptions: The system does not perform automatic trimming of whitespace before verification, as per the requirement to verify the entire submitted password without modification.

steps.action: Submit the valid password with a single trailing space character.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password as incorrect, verifying the entire string including the whitespace.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during establishment
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created (activation step). The system has an active blocklist containing common and compromised passwords.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password that is present in the blocklist (e.g., a top-10 breached password) and meets the minimum length requirement (15 characters).

steps.action: Submit a password that is known to be on the blocklist during the account activation process.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and does not create the account with this secret.

steps.action: Observe the user interface response after rejection.
steps.expected: The system displays a message indicating the password is not allowed and prompts the user to select a different password.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during change
test_cases.preconditions: An existing company representative account is logged in. The user has access to the password change function.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password that is present in the blocklist (e.g., a dictionary word or common pattern) and meets the minimum length requirement (15 characters).

steps.action: Navigate to the password change section and submit a new password that is known to be on the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system rejects the new password and the current password remains active.

steps.action: Observe the user interface response after rejection.
steps.expected: The system displays an error message stating the password is invalid or commonly used, requiring a different selection.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of strong password not on blocklist
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created or an existing account is changing its password.
test_cases.test_inputs: A random, high-entropy password of at least 15 characters that is not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit a strong, random password that is not found in the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and completes the establishment or change process successfully.

test_cases.title: Entire password matches blocklist entry
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists. The blocklist contains a specific 15-character string (e.g., 'CommonPassword123') that is known to be compromised.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new password identical to the blocklist entry 'CommonPassword123'.

steps.action: Attempt to change the password to the exact string 'CommonPassword123'.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and indicates it is on the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Password contains blocklist entry as substring
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists. The blocklist contains the string 'CommonPassword123'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new password that contains 'CommonPassword123' as a substring but is not identical to it (e.g., 'XCommonPassword123Y').

steps.action: Attempt to change the password to 'XCommonPassword123Y'.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password, as the entire string is not on the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Password contains blocklist word but not full entry
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists. The blocklist contains the word 'password' or a specific phrase, but the requirement specifies comparison of the *entire* password, not substrings or words. To test this strictly, we assume the blocklist contains a specific multi-word phrase or long string, and we test a password that shares a word but differs in structure/length.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new password that shares a common word with a blocklisted entry but is structurally different and not a substring of the blocklisted entry (e.g., if 'MySecretPass' is blocklisted, use 'PassMySecret').
test_cases.assumptions: The blocklist comparison is exact match on the full string, not fuzzy or substring-based.

steps.action: Attempt to change the password to a string that shares a word with a blocklisted entry but is not the full entry and does not contain the full entry as a substring.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password, confirming that only the entire string is compared.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a blocklisted password with reason display
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. A password known to be on the blocklist (e.g., a common breached password) is available for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: A blocklisted password of at least 15 characters.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the blocklisted password in the new password field and submit the form.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a message stating the reason for rejection (e.g., 'Password is too common' or 'Password is on the blocklist').

steps.action: Verify that the password field is cleared or remains editable for a new selection.
steps.expected: The user is able to enter a different password.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a context-specific blocklisted password with reason display
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. A password derived from the service name or organization name (context-specific) that is on the blocklist is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A context-specific blocklisted password of at least 15 characters.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the context-specific blocklisted password in the new password field and submit the form.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a message stating the reason for rejection.

test_cases.title: Guidance displayed after blocklist rejection
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change. A password known to be on the blocklist (e.g., a common breached password) is prepared.
test_cases.test_inputs: A blocklisted password of at least 15 characters.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter a password that is on the blocklist and submit the form.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a message indicating the password is on the blocklist.

steps.action: Observe the interface for guidance on choosing a strong password.
steps.expected: Guidance on choosing a strong password is displayed to the user, specifically following the rejection.

test_cases.title: Guidance displayed after context-specific word rejection
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change. A context-specific word (e.g., derivative of the service name) is prepared as a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: A context-specific password of at least 15 characters.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change screen for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter a password that is a context-specific word (e.g., 'VatandasBasvuruPortali123') and submit the form.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a message indicating the password is on the blocklist.

steps.action: Observe the interface for guidance on choosing a strong password.
steps.expected: Guidance on choosing a strong password is displayed to the user, specifically following the rejection.

test_cases.title: Password manager autofill functionality is supported
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A password manager is installed and configured in the test browser.

steps.action: Navigate to the password entry page for the company representative (e.g., login or password change).
steps.expected: The password input field is accessible and does not have attributes that prevent autofill (e.g., autocomplete is not set to 'off' or 'nope' in a way that blocks standard managers).

steps.action: Trigger the password manager's autofill feature for the password field.
steps.expected: The password manager successfully populates the password field with the stored credential.

steps.action: Submit the form with the autofilled password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input and processes the authentication or password change request without error related to input method.

test_cases.title: Paste functionality is permitted for password entry
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A valid password is copied to the clipboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the password entry page for the company representative.
steps.expected: The password input field is active and ready for input.

steps.action: Paste the copied password into the password field using keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+V) or context menu.
steps.expected: The pasted password appears in the field (masked or visible depending on UI settings) and is not blocked or cleared by the application.

steps.action: Submit the form.
steps.expected: The system processes the pasted password correctly.

test_cases.title: Recovery using two codes from different methods
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with a saved recovery code and a recovery contact configured. The account is in a state requiring recovery (e.g., password reset initiated).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid saved recovery code, valid recovery contact verification code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the representative account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods, including the use of recovery codes and recovery contacts.

steps.action: Select the option to use a saved recovery code and enter a valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for a second recovery method from a different source (e.g., recovery contact).

steps.action: Select the recovery contact option and provide the valid verification code sent to the recovery contact.
steps.expected: The system accepts the second code, verifies that the methods are different, and completes the recovery process, allowing the user to set a new password or regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery using one code and bound single-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with a saved recovery code and a bound single-factor authenticator (e.g., TOTP app or SMS to a verified number). The account is in a state requiring recovery.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid saved recovery code, valid TOTP code or SMS code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the representative account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods.

steps.action: Select the option to use a recovery code and enter a valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and prompts for authentication with a bound single-factor authenticator.

steps.action: Provide the valid code from the bound single-factor authenticator (e.g., TOTP or SMS).
steps.expected: The system verifies the authenticator, completes the recovery process, and allows the user to regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery using repeated identity proofing
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 that has been previously identity-proofed. The account is in a state requiring recovery.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid identity proofing documents and biometric data (if applicable) matching the initial proofing.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports repeated identity proofing as a recovery method for AAL2 accounts.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the 'Repeated Identity Proofing' option.
steps.expected: The system initiates the identity proofing workflow, requesting the necessary documents or biometric data.

steps.action: Submit valid identity proofing data that matches the records from the initial identity proofing.
steps.expected: The system verifies the identity, completes the recovery process, and allows the user to regain access.

test_cases.title: Recovery failure with two codes from the same method
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with two saved recovery codes available. The account is in a state requiring recovery.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid saved recovery codes.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use two recovery codes.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first recovery code.

steps.action: Enter a valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for the second recovery code.

steps.action: Enter a second valid saved recovery code (from the same method/source as the first).
steps.expected: The system rejects the recovery attempt, indicating that two codes from different methods are required, and does not complete the recovery.

test_cases.title: Recovery failure with invalid recovery code
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2. The account is in a state requiring recovery.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or expired recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use a recovery code.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the recovery code.

steps.action: Enter an invalid or expired recovery code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code, displays an error message, and does not proceed to the next step or complete the recovery.

test_cases.title: Disabling multiple authenticators when both fail consecutively
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with password and TOTP authenticators bound. The system is configured to disable authenticators after 50 consecutive failed attempts (per VBP SDD §14).
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for disabling is 50 consecutive failed attempts for each authenticator type.

steps.action: Perform 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the password authenticator (entering incorrect passwords).
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled. The system indicates that the password is no longer valid for authentication.

steps.action: Perform 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the TOTP authenticator (entering incorrect TOTP codes) on the same account.
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator is disabled. The system indicates that the TOTP authenticator is no longer valid for authentication.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the correct password and a valid TOTP code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system does not accept either the password or the TOTP code because both authenticators are disabled.

test_cases.title: Disabling only the authenticator that reaches the threshold
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with password and TOTP authenticators bound. The system is configured to disable authenticators after 50 consecutive failed attempts (per VBP SDD §14).
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for disabling is 50 consecutive failed attempts for each authenticator type.

steps.action: Perform 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the password authenticator (entering incorrect passwords).
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Perform 49 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the TOTP authenticator (entering incorrect TOTP codes).
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator remains active and is not disabled.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using a valid TOTP code and the correct password.
steps.expected: Authentication fails because the password authenticator is disabled, even though the TOTP authenticator is still active.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password authenticator bound. The failed-attempt threshold (50) is defined in VBP Software Design Document §14. The account is not currently locked or disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The re-binding process for a password authenticator involves resetting the password via the account recovery or security settings flow, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Make 50 consecutive failed password authentication attempts on the company representative account to trigger the disabling of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled. Subsequent attempts with the correct password are rejected.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the correct password without performing any re-binding action.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled or requires re-binding.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the password authenticator (e.g., reset password via recovery codes or security question) and complete it successfully.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is re-bound to the account. The system confirms the re-binding.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the new password.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The representative is logged in.

test_cases.title: Disabled TOTP authenticator requires re-binding before use
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a TOTP authenticator bound. The failed-attempt threshold (50) is defined in VBP Software Design Document §14. The account is not currently locked or disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials and TOTP secret.
test_cases.assumptions: The re-binding process for a TOTP authenticator involves generating a new TOTP secret and scanning the QR code or entering the secret into the authenticator app, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Make 50 consecutive failed TOTP authentication attempts (using incorrect TOTP codes) on the company representative account to trigger the disabling of the TOTP authenticator.
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator is disabled. Subsequent attempts with valid TOTP codes are rejected.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using a valid TOTP code without performing any re-binding action.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled or requires re-binding.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the TOTP authenticator (e.g., generate a new TOTP secret and update the authenticator app) and complete it successfully.
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator is re-bound to the account. The system confirms the re-binding.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using a valid TOTP code generated from the new secret.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The representative is logged in.

test_cases.title: AAL2 altında gelen e-Devlet yanıtının sınırlı kipte işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test kimlik sağlayıcısına entegredir. Test ortamında AAL1 düzeyinde kimlik doğrulama yapılabilecek bir e-Devlet test hesabı mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP'nin AAL2 altı doğrulamaları 'sınırlı kip' olarak tanımladığı ve bu kipte kişisel verilerin gizlendiği VBP-YTB-001 §4.2'de belirtilmiştir.

steps.action: AAL1 düzeyinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir e-Devlet oturumuyla VBP'ye giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: VBP, gelen yanıtın AAL2 gereksinimini karşılamadığını algılar ve oturumu 'sınırlı kip'te açar.

steps.action: Sınırlı kipte kullanıcı arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği gösterilmez; daha güçlü bir doğrulama yöntemiyle yeniden giriş önerisi sunulur.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL alanlarının eksik olduğu yanıtın reddedilmesi veya yönlendirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test kimlik sağlayıcısına entegredir. Test ortamında kimlik belirtecinde `acr` veya `amr` alanları eksik bırakılabilecek bir simülasyon imkânı vardır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP, xAL alanlarının eksik olması durumunda isteği reddetme veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirme mekanizmalarından birini kullanır (VBP-YTB-001 §4.2).

steps.action: `acr` alanı eksik olan bir e-Devlet kimlik yanıtı VBP'ye iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtı kabul etmez; kullanıcıya hata mesajı gösterilir veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirilir.

steps.action: `amr` alanı eksik olan bir e-Devlet kimlik yanıtı VBP'ye iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtı kabul etmez; kullanıcıya hata mesajı gösterilir veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: FAL gereksinimini karşılamayan federasyon yanıtının işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test kimlik sağlayıcısına entegredir. Test ortamında FAL düzeyi düşürülmüş bir federasyon yanıtı simüle edilebilir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP, FAL2 düzeyini gerektirir ve bu düzeyin altındaki yanıtı tanımlı mekanizmayla (ret veya yönlendirme) işler (VBP-YTB-001 §4.2).

steps.action: FAL düzeyi VBP'nin gereksiniminin altında olan bir e-Devlet federasyon yanıtı VBP'ye iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtı kabul etmez; kullanıcıya hata mesajı gösterilir veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Session AAL does not exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The system allows authentication at AAL1 (password only) and AAL2 (password + second factor).
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes the current session AAL level via a debug endpoint or logs for verification purposes.

steps.action: Authenticate to the portal using only a password (AAL1).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds and a session is established.

steps.action: Check the AAL level associated with the active session.
steps.expected: The session AAL is reported as AAL1.

steps.action: Attempt to access a resource that requires AAL2 without performing additional authentication.
steps.expected: Access is denied or the user is prompted to upgrade authentication to AAL2. The session does not automatically become AAL2.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The system allows authentication at AAL2 (password + second factor).
test_cases.assumptions: The system configuration allows sessions to be treated at a lower AAL than the authentication event if explicitly configured or if the application logic permits it (e.g., for low-risk operations).

steps.action: Authenticate to the portal using password and second factor (AAL2).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds and a session is established.

steps.action: Access a low-risk resource that is configured to accept AAL1 or higher.
steps.expected: Access is granted. The session is treated as valid for this resource, even though the authentication event was AAL2. The session AAL remains AAL2, but it is not rejected for being 'too high'.

test_cases.title: Session AAL cannot be artificially elevated above authentication event
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user has authenticated at AAL1 (password only).
test_cases.assumptions: The session token or cookie structure is known to allow inspection or manipulation in a test environment.

steps.action: Authenticate to the portal using only a password (AAL1).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds and a session is established with AAL1.

steps.action: Manipulate the session token or cookie to claim AAL2 (if the AAL is stored client-side or in a modifiable token), or attempt to invoke an API endpoint that expects AAL2 using the AAL1 session token.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request or treats the session as AAL1. The session is not upgraded to AAL2 based on client-side claims or token manipulation.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session does not fall back to HTTP
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is authenticated via HTTPS.

steps.action: Authenticate as a user via the HTTPS endpoint.
steps.expected: Authentication is successful and an active session is established over HTTPS.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the session cookie/token via an HTTP (insecure) URL.
steps.expected: The request is rejected or redirected to HTTPS; the session is not accepted over the insecure transport.

test_cases.title: Session remains valid over HTTPS after initial authentication
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists.

steps.action: Authenticate as a user via the HTTPS endpoint.
steps.expected: Authentication is successful.

steps.action: Access a protected resource using the session via an HTTPS URL.
steps.expected: The resource is served successfully, confirming the session is active and valid over the secure transport.

test_cases.title: Bot detection blocks automated identity proofing attempts
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing endpoint is accessible. A script or tool capable of simulating automated browser behavior (e.g., headless browser or raw HTTP requests without proper headers) is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Automated request payload mimicking a valid identity proofing submission.
test_cases.assumptions: The system's bot detection mechanism is configured to flag non-interactive or scripted traffic as malicious.

steps.action: Send an automated identity proofing request using a script that lacks standard browser headers or exhibits rapid, non-human interaction patterns.
steps.expected: The request is rejected or blocked by the bot detection mechanism. No identity proofing process is initiated for this request.

steps.action: Check the system logs or security dashboard for the blocked request.
steps.expected: The event is logged as a blocked automated attack or bot detection trigger.

test_cases.title: Web Application Firewall blocks malicious input during identity proofing
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing endpoint is protected by a WAF. A valid user session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request containing a known SQL injection or XSS payload in the identity proofing form fields.
test_cases.assumptions: The WAF is configured to block common attack vectors such as SQLi and XSS.

steps.action: Submit an identity proofing form where one of the text fields contains a malicious script or SQL injection string.
steps.expected: The WAF intercepts the request and returns a block page or error response. The malicious input is not processed by the backend application.

steps.action: Verify that the user's session is not compromised and the application remains stable.
steps.expected: The application continues to function normally for other requests. The specific malicious request is logged as a WAF violation.

test_cases.title: Behavioral analytics flags anomalous identity proofing activity
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists. The behavioral analytics engine is active and monitoring for anomalies.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of identity proofing attempts from a new IP address or device with rapid, unusual data entry patterns.
test_cases.assumptions: The system defines 'anomalous' behavior to include rapid data entry or access from unrecognized locations/devices.

steps.action: Initiate an identity proofing process from a new device/IP and complete the form with unusually fast data entry (e.g., copy-paste or auto-fill at machine speed).
steps.expected: The behavioral analytics system flags the session as suspicious. The user may be challenged with additional verification steps (e.g., CAPTCHA or step-up authentication) or the process is halted.

steps.action: Review the security logs for the flagged session.
steps.expected: The event is recorded with details of the anomalous behavior detected by the analytics engine.

test_cases.title: Network traffic analysis identifies high-risk indicators
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP is configured to analyze network traffic for high-risk indicators (e.g., blocklisted IPs). A test client is configured to use a known blocklisted proxy or IP address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Identity proofing request originating from a blocklisted IP address.
test_cases.assumptions: The system maintains a list of blocklisted IPs or proxies and checks incoming traffic against it.

steps.action: Attempt to access the identity proofing page and submit a request from a client using a known blocklisted IP address or proxy.
steps.expected: The network traffic analysis component identifies the source as high-risk. The request is blocked or the user is denied access to the identity proofing process.

steps.action: Check the security logs for the blocked connection.
steps.expected: The event is logged as a network traffic violation due to a high-risk source indicator.

test_cases.title: TOTP kodunun geçerlilik süresi içinde ikinci kez kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: TOTP ikinci faktör olarak bağlı, aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Testçi, TOTP uygulamasına erişebilmektedir.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi, geçerli bir TOTP kodu ile kimlik doğrulama işlemini tamamlar.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve oturum açılır.

steps.action: Aynı TOTP kodu hâlâ geçerlilik penceresi içindeyken (30 saniyelik adım içinde), yeni bir kimlik doğrulama işlemi başlatılır ve aynı kod girilir.
steps.expected: VBP kodu reddeder ve kimlik doğrulama başarısız olur.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent upon issuing a replacement saved recovery code
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a valid saved recovery code. The tester has access to the registered notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the account.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the request and issues a new saved recovery code.

steps.action: Check the registered notification channel (e.g., email inbox) for a message.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received, indicating that a replacement recovery code was issued.

test_cases.title: Saved recovery code invalidation and replacement issuance
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a valid saved recovery code. The tester has access to the account recovery interface and the account settings.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account and enter the current valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and completes the recovery process.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to a subdomain of the portal (e.g., https://api.portal.kdh.gov.tr).
steps.expected: The response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the same max-age and includeSubDomains directives.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to a static asset or API endpoint on the portal.
steps.expected: The response includes the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the correct directives.

test_cases.title: HSTS header present on error responses

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request with an invalid method or malformed data to trigger a 400 or 500 error.
